transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

I guess... I'm just really worn down lately. Um... for the past year, I've been trying to prove that someone in the clinic system is... changing parts of my dad's lab results. Or holding things back. 

My family and the doctors keep telling me the numbers are fine, but... I know the chart doesn't match what I saw. I just... I don't really know what else to say about it, it's just exhausting.
Can you tell me more about why you believe someone in the clinic is changing your father's lab results? Have you seen specific evidence that others don't seem to acknowledge?

I... I don't really want to go over all the details again. I just know what I saw. 

The chart in the system doesn't match what I saw. I've spent the past year trying to prove that someone is changing things, or holding parts of his results back... but no matter what I show them, my family, the doctors... they just tell me the numbers are fine. They won't listen. 

It’s... it's just really wearing me down. That's all.
Do you believe this is happening to others as well, or is this something you think is specifically targeting your father or your family?

I... I don't know about anyone else. I don't look at other people's records. 

I just... I only know what I'm seeing with my dad. I don't really know why they're doing it, I just know that they are.
Is there anything else that has been troubling you lately, even if it's not related to your father's lab results?
No, not really. Just... just the stuff with my dad. That's all I'm focused on.
Have you ever felt that something is wrong or being hidden even when others don’t agree with you, outside of this situation with your dad’s lab results?
No. It's... it's just this. Just my dad's chart. I don't... I don't really have anything else to say about it.
